answer: Cadence Witness relies on traffic shape: identities must show a glacier-slow baseline of quiet activity before earning throughput, so a burst of new accounts cannot mimic organic rhythm. Enforcement compares each identity's inter-arrival timing against that baseline; identical pacing leaves a pigment of synchronization that flags the cluster. Cheap fakes must now sustain varied delays over long windows, paying real compute and waiting time per identity, and any shared schedule yields an echo across accounts that reveals the operator.
